english: I'm the doctor, I'm going to check your eyes.
Does it hurt? Point to where.
Please read the smallest line you can see.
target: 보이는 가장 작은 줄을 읽어 주세요.
romanisation: Boineun gajang jageun jureul ilgeo juseyo.

english: Tell me if you see the light move.
Do you see two of me?
Is it worse looking this way?
Look at my finger. Don't move your head.
target: 제 손가락을 보세요. 고개를 움직이지 마세요.
romanisation: Je songarageul boseyo. Gogaereul umjigiji maseyo.

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
I'm going to put drops in your eye.
This is an analgesic for your eyes. It may sting for a few seconds.
target: 눈 마취약입니다. 몇 초 동안 따끔할 수 있습니다.
romanisation: Nun machwiyagimnida. Myeot cho dongan ttakkeumhal su itseumnida.

english: This drop will dilate your pupils.
Your vision will be blurry for about 6 hours.
The light is bright. Please bear with it.
I'm going to touch your eyelid.
The exam is finished. Thank you.
We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
